card.name: Inside the names niacin and riboflavin
card.fires_on: The final piece of the vitamin names niacin and riboflavin, such as the 'in' in Niacin or the 'of' in riboflavin. It appears mostly in niacin extended-release tablet labels.

modes.label: End of Niacin
modes.description: The closing 'in' or 'acin' of niacin when the word is split into pieces, often at the start of a sentence about extended-release tablets.
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS Niac<<in>> extended-release tablets are contraindicated

modes.label: Inside riboflavin
modes.description: The 'of' piece in the middle of riboflavin when listed among B vitamins.
